Title: Register with valid details
Preconditions: User is on Toolshop home page and is not logged in
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Sign in / Register. 2. Open Register form. 3. Enter valid first name; last name; unique email; password; and required registration fields. 4. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Registration succeeds; user is created and can proceed to login or is logged in as per app behavior.

Title: Login with registered credentials
Preconditions: Valid user already registered (from TC-M-01 or equivalent)
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Sign in. 2. Enter registered email and password. 3. Submit login.
Expected Result: Login succeeds; authenticated user session is established (account menu / user name visible).

Title: Browse products and open product detail
Preconditions: User is on Toolshop home / products catalog
Test Steps: 1. View product list on home/catalog. 2. Optionally use search or category filter. 3. Open one in-stock product.
Expected Result: Product list is displayed; product detail page shows name; price; and add-to-cart action.

Title: Add multiple items update quantity COD checkout and invoice with double confirm
Preconditions: User is logged in; products are available in catalog
Test Steps: 1. Add at least two products to cart (or one product twice via quantity). 2. Open cart and update quantity for a line item. 3. Proceed to checkout. 4. Enter billing details. 5. Select Cash on Delivery. 6. Confirm order. 7. Press Confirm again to generate invoice. 8. Open My Invoices and locate the new invoice.
Expected Result: Cart reflects updated quantity; COD checkout completes; invoice is generated only after second confirm; invoice is listed under My Invoices.

Title: Register with invalid or missing email
Preconditions: User is on Register form and is not logged in
Test Steps: 1. Open Register. 2. Leave email blank OR enter invalid email format. 3. Fill other required fields with valid data. 4. Submit.
Expected Result: Registration is rejected; validation/error message is shown; no new account is created.

Title: Login with wrong password
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Sign in. 2. Enter valid registered email with incorrect password. 3. Submit login.
Expected Result: Login fails; error message is shown; user remains unauthenticated.

Title: Checkout blocked when cart is empty
Preconditions: User is logged in; cart has zero items
Test Steps: 1. Ensure cart is empty (remove items if needed). 2. Attempt to proceed to checkout / place order.
Expected Result: Checkout cannot complete; user is blocked or warned that cart is empty; no invoice is created.

Title: Profile information matches registration data
Preconditions: User just registered and logged in with those credentials
Test Steps: 1. Complete valid registration (or use known registered user). 2. Log in. 3. Open profile / my account. 4. Compare displayed name and email to registration data.
Expected Result: Profile shows first name; last name; and email consistent with registration input.
